regime_context: The detector positions Industrial Metals as the leading momentum theme with high durability and breadth, but the absolute trend gate has historically failed to reduce drawdown in A-shares (gate_helps=false), and cross-sectional rank-IC is negligible. Combined with a track-record directional accuracy of 31.8%, the entire regime must be viewed as speculative—any trend-based lean comes with no validated edge in this market.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics (score 1.328) is narrowing the margin with Industrial Metals (1.49). Watch for a confirmed handoff: AI Compute's score overtakes Metals and its breadth rises above 0.3. Retire the watch if the score margin widens to >0.5 in favor of Industrial Metals.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals sits atop the momentum stack with strong durability (0.86) and very broad participation (breadth 0.92), suggesting that the trend is cohesive and not stretched. In a market known for sharp mean reversion, this level of structural persistence is unusual and warrants a modest tactical overweight, even though the historical trend-gate failure means the call is fragile.
theses.dissent: A-shares reliably revert; the gate failure record signals that even wide-breadth trends can dissolve quickly, particularly if macro or policy shocks hit the industrial complex.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute generates strong headline momentum (rank #2) but is carried by a very narrow set of stocks (breadth 0.18) and moderate durability (0.58). Low breadth signals a fragile trend that is unlikely to sustain without widening participation; therefore we lean underweight relative to broader cyclicals.
theses.dissent: A concentrated AI catalyst or fresh capex cycle could rapidly lift the whole theme, invalidating the fragility signal and reversing relative weakness.
